note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the user-namespace conversion (25fbb6e890/d8427e4380): the TestVRRPBackupDoesNotForwardVirtualMACFrames unit gained only `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }` as its first statement and its build tag moved from integration&&linux to linux. userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-runs the one named test in a fresh user+net+mount namespace and returns false to the parent only when the child reported PASS or SKIP; a failing child, a non-zero exit, or a child that ran nothing calls t.Fatalf, so every assertion below the guard still fails the test when the behaviour breaks. Body otherwise byte-identical. RFC 3768 Section 6.4.3: "MUST forward packets with a destination link layer MAC address equal to the virtual router MAC address." Fresh judgement: after clearBackupFilter and the address install the datagram sent to the Virtual Router MAC must reach the next hop, while the filtered phase must not, so the master-phase assertion is contrasted. TestBackupDiscardFollowsTheState pins the withdraw-after-install ordering. Enforced.
